summary: Amber International Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release and notice convening its 2026 Annual General Meeting for October 23, 2026 in Singapore, with a record date of September 28, 2026. Proposals include a special resolution granting CEO Michael Wu a one-off fully vested award of 23,469,189 Class B ordinary shares issued October 23, 2026, ratification of director appointments, and approval of an amended Post-IPO Share Incentive Plan raising the Class A reserve to 11,000,000 shares. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch dilution and governance implications of the large Class B award.
